scientific_integrity.correctness_basis: Statewise Poisson generator identities, exact stationary moments, predictable quadratic variation, stationary ergodic and bounded-jump martingale CLT.
scientific_integrity.novelty_scope: Exact three-state active-work fluctuation coefficient and covariance-matched two-versus-three-state sign reversal, not prior stationary positional laws or the known two-state comparator.
scientific_integrity.statement: Analytical finite-state-generator and martingale theorem; explicit rate constants independently verified symbolically and by an event-driven numerical experiment.

scientific_limitations: Stationary initial conditions, an overdamped harmonic trap, exponentially distributed run/rest dwell times, and zero translational Brownian noise.
Equality is only for two-time covariances, not full path distributions; active mechanical work is not claimed to be total entropy production.
Long-time work variance rate and Gaussian scaling are proved; a global large-deviation principle and non-Markovian extensions are not.
Two-state comparator may be deduced from an earlier diffusive two-state calculation and is not counted as novel; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Work-noise order reversal for covariance-matched run-and-rest and telegraph drives
